rules.rationale: This priority rule consumes the exact translated while-loop and updates the active value and digits bindings, so its behavior is an execution transition in the verification model rather than a mathematical definition or fact.

This simplification asserts the binary-value invariant of loopDigits under a guarded domain; it does not define a fresh summary symbol, and every simplification rule must be classified as DEFINITION or DOMAIN_LEMMA.
This simplification is a normalized variant of the binary-value invariant with a leading factor of one; it is an additional guarded mathematical fact, not a defining equation for a named proof term.
